correctness.rationale: All 32767 nonempty principal submatrices of F_15 were checked in EACH of two degree-four F_7 extensions generated by the two displayed quartic factors of Phi_15. Independent C++17 exact finite-field implementation constructed 2401-element fields, checked inverses and primitive fifteenth-root orders, eliminated every mask, and returned precisely 30 singular masks per orbit with discrepancy count 0 against 15 translates of B={0,2,3,6,7,9} plus complements; max nullity 1. The Frobenius orbits of length four account for all 8 primitive roots. The seed determinant factor 35 gives a characteristic-seven zero, translation is a diagonal row/column reweighting, and complementary principal singularity follows Jacobi identity with invertible F. This is an exhaustive finite theorem, NOT an inference about complex order-15 or order-105 minors.
residual_risks: Characteristic seven, index order fifteen; no complex singularity or failure of every possible lifting method.
